Hello, its nice to meet you!  My name is Huntress, and I love the color green.  

I'd like to request a sticker sheet of my character!  The expressions and poses are completely up to you.  If possible, I'd also like to request at least one chibi of my character and a sphere frog.  Feel free to include frog emotes too, if you'd like!

My VTuber's theme is lotus flowers, frogs, and lilypads!  Her personality is a bit seductive, like the reference picture 1 and 2, yet also somewhat degenerate, like Futaba from Persona 5.

I'd like to request a sticker sheet of my character!  The expressions and poses are completely up to you.  If possible, I'd also like to request at least one chibi of my character and a sphere frog.  Feel free to include frog stickers too, if you'd like!

I love the expressions you did for https://skeb.jp/@yuriika_draw/works/53 and https://skeb.jp/@yuriika_draw/works/49 !

Its completely up to you whether to include the glasses, ears, or pepe hat.  I don't mind my VTuber model without them ^_^ 

In the reference URL: 
1 and 2 is artwork with and without the "Keqing" ears, 3,4,5,6, 8 are some expressions on my VTuber model, and on 7 (a little NSFW, just a lot of skin showing) is the sphere frog.  For the frog, feel free to change the color to a lighter shade of green, if you would like!  9 is an alternate hairstyle, feel free to use that if you would like.

This would be for use on Twitch, Discord, and Youtube.  And to maybe merchandise in the future.  If possible, can you put the stickers and background on separate layers?  Thank you!
